build_always_one_dataset: build a dataset using AlwaysOneBuilder that returns a NumbersDataset with all values set to one
load_always_one_dataset: load an always_one dataset by calling AlwaysOneBuilder.load with a config and dataset type
register_always_one_builder: register the AlwaysOneBuilder class in the MMF registry under the name always_one
get_always_one_config_path: get the config path for the always_one dataset builder via the config_path classmethod
review_always_one_builder: review the AlwaysOneBuilder class and its load method that creates a NumbersDataset with always_one=True
